questions.question: In August 2026, which outermost customer organizations on the hosted SaaS service had the most people using the work-scheduling features, and which edition were they on during August?
On GitLab.com, how did the number of people active over a rolling 30-day window in each DevOps phase split between paid and free, for each of January through December 2026?
How many outermost groups or personal spaces on GitLab.com went over their included CI compute allowance in October 2026, and how many of those were consuming extra compute time they had bought?
How many top-level groups hold more data on disk than the no-cost allowance covers, and how is that data divided between Docker images, pipeline output files and software libraries?
For October 2026, how many places for the AI assistant had each customer bought, how many of those were given out to individuals, and how many of those individuals really used it?
In FY2027 Q2, what percentage of the AI-written snippets that appeared on screen did developers take up, broken out by programming dialect and by the editing application they work in?
In each month of 2026, how many top-level groups began their initial free evaluation period, broken out by how big the business is and which nation it is in?

In September 2026, for each customer contract on the customer-hosted deployment option, how many people were actually using the software versus how many people they were paying for, and which contracts exceeded what they bought?

In September 2026, what proportion of customer-hosted instances sent in the 30-day active-people figure for each DevOps phase, and what is the projected overall figure once the silent instances are taken into account?
How much recurring revenue did we have in July 2026 from customers on our top-priced edition?

In FY2027 Q2, how much annualized recurring revenue did we gain from first-time customers versus lose through customers leaving, compared with the preceding period, broken out by customer-size bracket and world region?
As of January 2026, what fraction of the annualized recurring revenue that our top-level customer organizations in EMEA gave us in January 2025 did we still keep, ignoring any expansion?
In FY2027 Q4, how much annualized recurring revenue is due to be re-signed, broken out by the territory of the seller responsible?
Which bills we sent to customers are past due at this moment, and how much is still owed in each overdue-age bracket and for each set of agreed pay-within arrangements?
For every month of FY2026, what were our days sales outstanding and our collection effectiveness index?
In FY2026 Q4, on average what percentage reduction from the published cost did final buyers receive on Premium licences bought via reseller companies, by geographic territory?
For each month of FY2026, how did the sum of contracts we signed compare with what we charged customers and the cash we actually received?

How much did we spend on Google's cloud hosting in September 2026, broken out by income-statement heading and by the part of what we sell that it supports, after adjusting for consumption we had prepaid for?
How many bids did we come out ahead on in FY2027 Q2 where a particular rival was also bidding, per rival?
On average, how many days do potential deals sit at each step of the sales process before they are won or lost?
For the current quarter, by sales segment, how many times over does the value of deals we are working on cover our target?
For FY2027 Q3, how much annualized recurring revenue, after subtracting losses, did each head of selling predict in their most recent seven-day-cycle projection?

In FY2026, how many potential purchases came in through outside companies formally claiming a customer they intend to pursue, broken out by the outside company and by the kind of programme it belongs to?
Which customers have the highest likelihood-to-expand marks and sit at the Decision or Purchase point of the purchasing journey?
Which contract re-signings due to close in FY2027 Q4 are flagged as in danger, how much annualized recurring revenue could move up or down on each, and who is the person responsible for it?
In October 2026, how many get-togethers did we hold with each client company, split by what sort of get-together it was?
In each of Q1 through Q4 of FY2027, how many promotion-qualified prospects, those judged ready to hand to sellers, did each world territory generate, and how does that compare with the goal for them?
In FY2026, how much revenue was credited to each marketing initiative under the W-pattern credit-splitting method?
For the mass mailings we dispatched in September 2026, how many reached inboxes, how many were read, how many had a link tapped, and how many recipients opted out, for each mailing?

Of the individuals who raised their hand in FY2027 Q1, how many went on to be judged ready by the promotion team, and how many then became a potential purchase that sellers took on, broken out by where each individual originally came from?
How many people have agreed to receive promotional electronic mail from us and also hold a no-cost top-level organization or personal space on the hosted online service?
In FY2027 Q2, which promotional routes to customers get the most credit for moving deals up the sales outlook, from early funnel to best case or commit?
In September 2026, how many proposals to combine code changes were opened on GitLab.com aimed at the main line of development versus other lines, leaving out removed ones?
Last month, which of our own in-house code repositories used the most CI computing time on shared execution agents, and how many automated workflows and individual tasks did they run?
Which unresolved defects in our engineering work tracker are linked to the most client revenue via help-desk requests that refer to them, and how long have they been unresolved?
In FY2026, how much turnover was by choice versus forced, broken out by the cause of departure?
How many people do we have today, by geographic territory and nation, and how many of them joined within the past 12 months?
In October 2026, what percentage of our in-house software developers used AI-assistant capabilities on the days they were on shift, broken out by the part of the company they belong to?
For help-desk cases opened by Premium clients in October 2026, what is the median duration until the initial response, broken out by how urgent the case is?

Which clients got a red mark in their wellbeing assessment, either for uptake of CI or for how much of their purchased entitlement they actually put to use, during the most recently completed calendar cycle?
